entities.summary: Donald Paul Hahn is an American film producer. He served as a producer for the Disney films Beauty and the Beast, The Lion King (1994),  The Hunchback of Notre Dame (1996), Atlantis: The Lost Empire (2001), and The Haunted Mansion (2003).
